主要内容: DISH Network Corporation announced in its Form 8-K filing dated February 15, 2013, that it had completed the acquisition of most of the assets of Blockbuster, Inc. in April 2011, which was reported as its Blockbuster segment. As part of this acquisition, DISH acquired Blockbuster operations in the United States and certain foreign countries, including the United Kingdom. On January 16, 2013, the Blockbuster UK operating subsidiaries entered into administration proceedings in the UK. Administrators were appointed to sell or liquidate the assets of these entities for the benefit of their creditors. Since DISH no longer exercises control over these entities, it will deconsolidate Blockbuster UK during the first quarter of 2013. As a result, DISH is required to write down the assets of Blockbuster UK to their estimated net realizable value as of December 31, 2012, resulting in a $21 million charge. Additionally, DISH has intercompany receivables of $37 million due from Blockbuster UK as of December 31, 2012. DISH currently believes it will not receive the full amount for these receivables, leading to an additional $25 million impairment charge related to these receivables. DISH Network Corporation reported in its 8-K filing dated February 15, 2013, that it had incurred an impairment charge of $46 million on a pre-tax basis related to the Administration. The company noted that the actual proceeds received from the Administration and the final impairment charge may differ from its initial estimates. The filing was signed by R. Stanton Dodge, Executive Vice President, General Counsel, and Secretary of DISH Network Corporation.
